current_authoritative_campaign_anchor.guard: These strategic dates/outcomes remain authoritative until the vehicle-layer reconstruction proves a material timing shift.

corrected_armored_force.8th_Tank_Regiment: NOT PRESENT: South Pacific/Rabaul commitment by late 1942
corrected_armored_force.important: This is about 50-80 tracked AFVs below the prior provisional four-regiment/full-division-scale upper assumption.

double_count_guard.therefore: Do NOT add a full 'tanks save infantry' bonus again. This audit mainly reallocates the magnitude, loss classes, consumption and residual strength; casualty-center movement is a correction, not a brand-new multiplier.

reason: rail/road-backed plains operations allow reliability and recovery to pay
Chinese AT guns, field artillery, mines and bridge demolitions still create real combat damage
higher dispatchability creates more contact and therefore more damaged vehicles

systemic_correction_vs_current_settlemen.explanation: The corrected force is smaller than the old provisional full-division image, while Branch reliability is better. Those effects largely cancel at campaign-total level. Existing 17-21k / 55-70k bands remain.
systemic_correction_vs_current_settlemen.Japanese_guns_trucks_engineer_assets_sav: roughly +10 to +25 vehicle/gun equivalents, mainly through better covered recovery and fewer road-side abandonments

Phase_II_Qinling_armor_cycle.doctrine: Do not push the medium-tank main body through the Qinling mountain road as if it were a plains armored exploitation.
Phase_II_Qinling_armor_cycle.composition: Ha-Go / selected Chi-Ha/Shinhoto / tankettes / engineer tractors; heavy repair and most medium reserve stay north

AFV_damage.mechanical_route_restriction: far more important than enemy tank combat

systemic_correction_vs_current_settlemen.explanation: Current settlement already models the mountains as the binding constraint. Better tanks cannot remove road tonnage, bridge geometry or engineer bottlenecks.

end_Hanzhong_1943_07_23_working.note: Most armor survives physically because Phase II intentionally refuses a mass tank push through the Qinling. That does not mean most is immediately ready.

late_1943_residual_implication.repair_return_Aug_Dec: Substantial. With branch repair culture, roughly 15-25 of the July long-repair vehicles can return before year-end, subject to parts and rail movement.
late_1943_residual_implication.training_crew_loss: Lower than a naive destroyed-hull model, preserving experienced crews and maintenance cadres.
late_1943_residual_implication.free_national_pool: ZERO. Surviving 3rd Tank Division armor remains China-theater committed, with Hanzhong/Guanzhong security and future operations consuming it.

strategic_judgment.FiveGo_casualty_bands: UNCHANGED centered; only small internal center shifts until regiment-level Chinese AT engagements are rebuilt
strategic_judgment.largest_change: The residual armor ledger and theater placement, not the conquest timetable.
strategic_judgment.why: The old campaign was already logistics-limited and already knew armor mattered. Correcting from a nominal four-regiment image to a physical three-regiment core prevents over-credit without erasing the Branch reliability advantage.

next_required: Build regiment-level 12th/13th/17th model mix at 25 Mar 1943.
Audit key Luoyang/Tongguan/Xian/Baoji AT-artillery contacts only, not every skirmish.
Post repair returns Aug-Dec and create 1943-12-31 China armor residual checkpoint.
Then combine China, Burma, NEI, Rabaul/New Caledonia, Kwantung/Home and training/repair pools into the national residual inventory.
